answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farms. Each epoch, a beacon assigns five random auditors to every identity, each staking 20 credits. An identity that tries to wander through fake selves must pass five audits per self, so 100 fakes face 500 audits and 10,000 credits in bonds, while honesty earns 120 per epoch. A sparrow leaves one trail across a dune; a sybil leaves a hundred for strangers to check. Honest agents pay one bond, keep their reward.
